Package com.cognizant.emk.multiagent.application.ratelimit

package com.cognizant.emk.multiagent.application.ratelimit
Rate-limit bounded context — application layer.

Hosts the two admin-facing use cases consumed by the RateLimitAdminController (US-13-006):

  • GetRateLimitConfigUseCase — read the live counters;
  • UpdateRateLimitConfigUseCase — replace the counters and notify the bucket adapter via RateLimitConfigChangeListener.

The listener interface inverts the dependency on the Bucket4j adapter (US-13-004): the bucket adapter implements the listener port so the application layer never imports infrastructure types. Populated by US-13-003.
